Two people are carrying a table.
A laptop computer is open on the table.

title: 词性：副词修饰动词
prompt: Please review the attached schedule _____ before confirming your availability.
explanation: 空格修饰动作review，需要副词carefully。careful是形容词，care和carefulness是名词，不能在这里修饰review。
evidence: Please review the attached schedule carefully before confirming your availability.
translation: 请仔细查看随附的日程，再确认你是否有空。

vocabulary.example: Please confirm your availability for Friday.

title: 期限表达
prompt: All expense reports must be submitted _____ Friday at 5 P.M.
explanation: by表示不晚于某个截止时间。until通常表示动作或状态持续到某时，不用于这里“必须在截止前提交”的意思；during后通常接一段时期。
evidence: All expense reports must be submitted by Friday at 5 P.M.
translation: 所有费用报销单都必须在周五下午五点之前提交。

vocabulary.example: I submitted my expense report yesterday.

title: 主谓一致
prompt: Each of the new employees _____ a security badge on the first day.
explanation: 主语核心是Each，按单数处理；一般现在时谓语用receives。不要被of后面的复数employees干扰。
evidence: Each of the new employees receives a security badge on the first day.
translation: 每位新员工都在第一天领到一张门禁卡。

vocabulary.example: Please wear your security badge inside the building.

title: 被动语态
prompt: The replacement printer _____ by a technician yesterday.
explanation: 打印机是被安装的，需要被动语态；yesterday表示过去，所以用was installed。by a technician也提示动作执行者。
evidence: The replacement printer was installed by a technician yesterday.
translation: 替换用的打印机昨天由一位技术员安装好了。

vocabulary.example: A replacement part will arrive tomorrow.

title: 连接词：让步关系
prompt: _____ the shipment arrived late, all items were in good condition.
explanation: “到货晚”与“物品完好”构成让步关系，用Although，表示虽然。During是介词，不能直接引导完整主谓句。
evidence: Although the shipment arrived late, all items were in good condition.
translation: 虽然货物到达晚了，但所有物品都完好无损。

vocabulary.example: The returned camera is in good condition.

title: 商务词汇：回应请求
prompt: Please _____ to the client's request within two business days.
explanation: respond to a request表示回应请求。其余词虽然也可能与to搭配或出现在商务语境中，但不能表达回应客户请求。
evidence: Please respond to the client's request within two business days.
translation: 请在两个工作日内回复客户的请求。

vocabulary.example: Our support team will respond to your message soon.

title: 关系代词
prompt: Applicants _____ portfolios demonstrate strong design skills will be invited for an interview.
explanation: 空格后有名词portfolios，表示申请人的作品集，因此用表示所属关系的whose。who和whom不能在这里直接修饰portfolios。
evidence: Applicants whose portfolios demonstrate strong design skills will be invited for an interview.
translation: 作品集能体现扎实设计能力的申请人将获邀参加面试。

vocabulary.example: Please attach a link to your online portfolio.

prompt: Several tablets are _____ for visitors who did not bring a laptop.
explanation: 系动词are后需要形容词作表语，available表示可供使用，A正确。availability是名词；avail是动词原形；availed是其过去式或过去分词，都不能构成这里自然且完整的表达。
evidence: Several tablets are available for visitors who did not bring a laptop.
translation: 有几台平板电脑可供没带笔记本电脑的访客使用。

title: 介词 · 提交截止时间
prompt: Please submit your travel request _____ Friday so that we can book the tickets next week.
explanation: by加时间表示不晚于该时间，符合周五前交申请、下周订票的顺序，B正确。since表示自某时起，通常与持续状态或完成时搭配；during不能自然修饰这里的单个截止日；while通常引导从句，不能直接接Friday。
evidence: Please submit your travel request by Friday so that we can book the tickets next week.
translation: 请最迟在周五提交出差申请，以便我们下周预订车票。

title: 被动语态 · 检查设备
prompt: All rental bicycles must be _____ by a technician before they are given to customers.
explanation: 自行车是被检查的，情态动词must后用be加过去分词构成被动语态，因此C inspected正确。inspecting是现在分词；inspection是名词；inspect是动词原形，均不能填入must be之后表达该被动关系。
evidence: All rental bicycles must be inspected by a technician before they are given to customers.
skill: 语态：情态动词后的被动
translation: 所有租赁自行车交给顾客之前，都必须由技术人员检查。

vocabulary.example: A technician tested the microphone before the presentation.

title: 连词 · 让步关系
prompt: _____ the train was crowded, Mia found a seat near the door.
explanation: 空格后是完整从句the train was crowded，需要能引导让步从句的Although，D正确。Despite和During是介词，不能直接接该完整从句；Instead是副词，不能独自连接这两个分句。
evidence: Although the train was crowded, Mia found a seat near the door.
translation: 虽然火车很拥挤，米娅还是在门边找到了座位。

vocabulary.example: The station is often crowded before a holiday.

title: 主谓一致 · 每位成员
prompt: Every month, each member of the support team _____ a short progress report.
explanation: 主语核心是each member，为单数；Every month说明经常性动作，故用一般现在时单数形式receives，A正确。B和D不与单数主语一致；C是非谓语形式，不能独立充当此句谓语。
evidence: Every month, each member of the support team receives a short progress report.
translation: 支持团队的每位成员每月都会收到一份简短的进度报告。

vocabulary.example: The progress report explains which tasks are complete.

title: 代词 · 名词前的所属关系
prompt: Please keep the temporary pass until you receive _____ replacement.
explanation: replacement在这里是名词，前面需要形容词性物主代词your，B正确。yours可独立使用但不能直接修饰名词；you是人称代词；yourself是反身代词，均不适合此处。
evidence: Please keep the temporary pass until you receive your replacement.
translation: 请保留临时通行证，直到收到替换用的新证。

title: 比较级 · 两个版本的效率
prompt: The new booking system is _____ than the previous version.

evidence: The new booking system is more efficient than the previous version.
